title: mentha × verticillata var. arguta
intro: Mentha × verticillata var. arguta, commonly known as Corn Mint, is a hybrid mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include aiding digestion, reducing nausea and vomiting, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Corn Mint include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiviral properties, making it a useful remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Corn Mint include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
